# Bundled fonts

These fonts are shipped inside the app (`app/src/main/res/font/`). Each is licensed under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1; the full licence and copyright notice for each one is in the
matching `*-OFL.txt` file here.

| File in the app | Font | Licence file |
|---|---|---|
| `inter.ttf` | Inter | `inter-OFL.txt` |
| `nunito.ttf` | Nunito | `nunito-OFL.txt` |
| `oswald.ttf` | Oswald | `oswald-OFL.txt` |
| `outfit.ttf` | Outfit | `outfit-OFL.txt` |
| `orbitron.ttf` | Orbitron | `orbitron-OFL.txt` |
| `space_grotesk.ttf` | Space Grotesk | `spacegrotesk-OFL.txt` |
| `playfair.ttf` | Playfair Display | `playfairdisplay-OFL.txt` |
| `kaushan.ttf` | Kaushan Script | `kaushanscript-OFL.txt` |
| `bebas_neue.ttf` | Bebas Neue | `bebasneue-OFL.txt` |
| `doto.ttf` | Doto | `doto-OFL.txt` |
| `stencil.ttf` | Big Shoulders Stencil Display | `bigshouldersstencildisplay-OFL.txt` |

Source: [github.com/google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts).
